comparison.objective: Join two boards evenly on three glued dowels.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual multi-pin alignment, even pressing, wedge avoidance, and released seating.
comparison.success_condition: Both seam corners within 0.5 mm, edges flush within 1 mm, boards flat, and grippers released and still for full credit; earlier versions use square sockets and later versions round bores.
comparison.reason: Multi-feature insertion and seating of rigid assemblies do not overlap with bulk granular separation.
